text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. A balanced diet gives you the energy you need, so try to eat plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains. Regular exercise, such as walking or swimming, keeps your heart strong and helps you relax. Getting enough sleep is also important, because your body repairs itself at night. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and make time for hobbies you enjoy. Finally, a good work-life balance helps you avoid stress. Small daily habits can make a big difference to how you feel.
